data_section_full_text:
3. Data and model development


Data
A questionnaire was sent to the controllers of all Fortune 1000 companies (financial
institutions and private companies were excluded) <sup>3</sup> asking them to provide the
amount of their external audit fee for the fiscal year ended between April 1992
and March 1993. <sup>4</sup> Beatty (1993) found a high degree of correspondence between
mandated public disclosures of audit fees (in the IPO prospectus) and audit fees
disclosed by way of questionnaire. This high degree of correspondence lends some
support to the self-reported audit fee data.
